title: Produce range component audit sheet
description: Audit the range filter as a component system before adding more controls, with special attention to vertical mode, labels, ticks, number inputs, handles, track, switchers, and responsive behavior.
objective: Turn the range slider from a technically working control into a component with explicit anatomy, switcher contracts, subelement controls, state matrix, and Guilherme QA scenarios.
inputs_required: Guilherme screenshot feedback for vertical range labels
expected_outputs: Range controls backlog split into now/later
acceptance_criteria: Labels, ticks, handles, track, selected track, base track, number inputs, orientation, and markers are treated as separate subelements.
Switcher-off behavior states whether markup should disappear or remain hidden without reserving layout.
The audit does not implement the range fixes yet.
The audit identifies which changes are mechanical bugs versus product customization.
verification: Audit document references the current render/CSS/JS files.
No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: range render, range CSS, range JS, user screenshot

risks: Skipping this audit would repeat the current bug pattern: technically working, visually underdesigned.
Overloading range with too many controls at once can bloat the Style panel.
